required_gates.requirement: The conservative located source record exists and validates.
Immediately before dry-run and admission, confirm both SHA-256 hashes and byte counts against this proposal.
Both bodies must pass Library Import dry-run before either is admitted.
A separately authorized bundled execution may admit both volumes; do not admit one as a complete work by itself.
Run library validate, render-index --check, verify-texts, and tests/test_archive_library.py once after the paired batch.
